families.family: wyrm — Godzilla (MonsterVerse evolutionary ladder, 5 forms: gz2014 baseline → burning → gvk → gxk evolved-pink → supernova speculative endpoint). ONE animal escalating; distinctness rides on plate jaggedness/height/count, body bulk/lean, and palette + self-illumination — NOT a different silhouette. Shared brand: hunched mountain of mass topped by a sawtooth dorsal ridge of broken-slate "maple-leaf" plates, small low-slung head on a thick neck, vestigial T-rex arms, elephantine legs, thick low tail. Reconciled against canonical refs: GareGoji (Edwards 2014), DougheGoji burning (KotM 2019), DougheGoji-revised (GvK 2021), Evolved/pink (GxK New Empire 2024), and the speculative GxK: Supernova 2027 endpoint (note: Supernova 2027 is a confirmed real film with SpaceGodzilla as villain — reinforces the cosmic-crystal endpoint read).

forms.character: Godzilla (2014) — GareGoji, the MonsterVerse baseline (Gareth Edwards)
forms.era: MonsterVerse / Legendary 2014 (Tier 0 anchor)
forms.oneLineIdentity: The naturalistic charcoal volcanic-rock bear-Godzilla: heaviest bulk, smallest noble head, short angular broken-slate fins, blue atomic glow only on the fins/breath.
forms.silhouette: Hunched mountain of mass — deep barrel chest, wide shoulders, thick elephantine legs, a deliberately SMALL low-slung head on a thick gilled neck, tiny T-rex arms, a thick low tail. Crowned by a row of SHORT, blunt, jagged dorsal fins. Reads as a heavy bear/sauropod, not a sleek raptor. This is the reference mass every other wyrm escalates from.
signatureCues: Short, blunt, ANGULAR broken-slate dorsal fins (canon ~89 fins, 'brittle and break' look — at iso: ~10 stubby jagged plates, the lowest/shortest of the whole ladder)
Charcoal volcanic-rock body — matte, dull, near-black grey with NO self-illumination (the only glow is the blue fin-edge/breath)
Heaviest, most bear-like bulk of the five (bulk ~1.05); deep torso, thick elephantine/sauropod feet
Small noble head set LOW on a thick neck — sells gigantic scale
Blue accent ONLY (cool blue plateGlow/breath) — no orange, no pink, no violet
Pale/white eyes ringed by grey veins (malevolent-mystical read) — portrait-only at iso

palette.color: #646464 (bumped from #565656 for a stronger value-break on rocky torso)

forms.materialFinish: Dull matte volcanic-rock / charcoal hide — porous, brittle, NON-reflective. The only luminance lift is the cool-blue fin edge. No rim self-illumination (house rim only).
mustHaveForBlindID: Charcoal/grey (NOT black, NOT brown, NOT tinted) matte rock skin
SHORT blunt jagged fins — visibly the shortest/stubbiest plates on the ladder
Heaviest bear-bulk + tiny low head proportion
Blue (cool) as the ONLY glow color — zero warm or pink/violet anywhere
NO body self-glow — body is fully unlit dull rock
commonMisreads: vs burning Godzilla — DISAMBIGUATE by surface: gz2014 is dull unlit grey rock; burning has glowing-orange lava cracks + incandescent fins. If you see ANY warm crack glow it's burning, not 2014.

vs gvk — DISAMBIGUATE by plate shape + bulk: gz2014 fins are SHORT/blunt and the body is heaviest; gvk fins are tall/sharp/slim (razor) and the torso is leaner. Blue glow appears on BOTH, so don't lean on color — lean on plate height and torso width.
vs a generic dragon/dinosaur — the broken-slate maple-leaf fin row + tiny-head/huge-body proportion is the tell.
hardAt40px: The 89-fin density and 'brittle broken-slate' texture collapse — imply with ~10 deterministically jittered plates (±25% width/height/lean) reading as irregular sawtooth rather than uniform triangles; keep them SHORT (height scalar ~0.85) so the silhouette is unmistakably the bluntest tier.
Grey-veined white eyes and chest scale-patterns are sub-pixel — drop them; carry identity on plate-shape + bulk + the dark plate-core figure-ground separation (lit skinLight face over #2b2b2b core).
The naturalistic gill-neck and elephant-foot detail don't survive — imply scale only via the small-head/thick-neck/wide-foot proportion.

forms.character: Burning Godzilla (Godzilla: King of the Monsters, 2019) — DougheGoji, super-charged molten form
forms.era: MonsterVerse / Legendary 2019 (Tier 1 — molten overlay). Lineage homage to Heisei Burning/Meltdown Godzilla (1995).
forms.oneLineIdentity: The same animal mid-meltdown: scorched near-black body LEAKING orange lava through cracked-skin fissures, with incandescent orange dorsal fins and a self-lit orange aura.
forms.silhouette: Identical heavy wyrm mass to gz2014, but the dorsal ridge is a notch TALLER and SHARPER (one visibly taller hot lead-plate breaks the skyline) and the whole figure is haloed by a soft heat aura/smoke. Same bulk (~1.05).
signatureCues: Glowing-orange LAVA FISSURE 'rashes' cracking across chest, belly and thighs — the #1 brand cue ('leaking active fire from every inch'); opaque hot cores so they read on a baked sprite
INCANDESCENT orange dorsal fins (re-sharpened toward 1954 jaggedness) — fins glow as if molten, hottest at the base, with one taller hot lead-plate
Scorched near-black/charred-brown body value (darker than gz2014's grey) — the cracks read because the skin between them is almost black
Full-silhouette ORANGE self-illumination rim (granted — canonically self-lit) + soft heat aura/smoke + heat motes
Red-gold glowing eyes (#ff8a2a)
Warm orange is the ONLY accent — no blue, no pink
forms.materialFinish: Charred volcanic crust over a molten interior — matte black-brown rock cracked open to expose glowing magma; fins read as cooling/heating molten metal. Emissive (self-lit), unlike gz2014.
mustHaveForBlindID: Glowing orange lava CRACKS across the torso (chest/belly/thigh) — without these it is NOT burning
Incandescent orange fins (molten, hottest at base)
Charred near-black body (darker than 2014 grey) so cracks pop
Orange self-glow / heat aura — body emits light
commonMisreads: vs gz2014 — DISAMBIGUATE by the lava cracks + orange glow: 2014 is dull unlit grey rock with cool-blue fins; any orange crack glow = burning.

vs supernova — BOTH have fissure cracks + self-illum rim + escalation feel. DISAMBIGUATE by HUE and PLATE SIZE: burning is ORANGE with normal-height (slightly tall) fins; supernova is WHITE-VIOLET with hugely overgrown crystalline plates + bigger bulk. Orange = burning, violet = supernova.
vs Rodan/magma forms — Rodan is an airborne pteranodon triangle; burning is the grounded plated wyrm. Silhouette resolves it instantly despite shared magma-crack palette.
hardAt40px: Fine smoke/steam plumes vanish — imply with a soft aura halo + a couple of opaque heat motes rather than wispy smoke.
The lava-crack network must NOT rely on additive blending (it's baked) — use 4–5 THICK (≥2.2px) opaque branching seams with bright cores, not many thin hairlines.
Per-fin molten gradient is the cheapest way to read 'incandescent' at iso — flat hot-orange fins + the orange rim also read; avoid 10+ separate glow halos.

Leaner, more athletic torso (the warrior cut) — visibly narrower than gz2014/burning bulk
2 BROKEN/chipped plates (~50% height, flat chipped top + notch) — 'spikes constantly growing and breaking' battle-scar asymmetry
Charcoal / brown-grey hide (still rock, like 2014 — NOT scorched, NOT tinted)
Cool atomic-BLUE fin glow/breath — same blue family as 2014 but on sharper fins; NO self-illum body rim (house rim only — gvk is NOT canonically self-lit)
More plates than any earlier tier (11) but irregular/scarred

palette.color: atomic blue ~#37c4ff / #4ad6ff (live FX glow, NOT a baked rim)

forms.materialFinish: Same dull charcoal volcanic-rock hide as gz2014 — matte, non-emissive body. The ONLY luminance is the cool-blue fin edge (live glow). Crucially NO self-illumination rim — its escalation is shape (lean + sharper/broken fins), not light.
mustHaveForBlindID: Leaner torso than gz2014/burning — the warrior silhouette
SHARP, slim, tall razor fins (clearly sharper than 2014's blunt stubs)
At least 1–2 visibly broken/chipped plates (battle scars)
Cool-blue fins on an UNLIT charcoal body (no orange, no pink, no body self-glow)
commonMisreads: vs gz2014 — same blue palette, so DO NOT use color. DISAMBIGUATE by plate sharpness/height + torso width: gvk = tall sharp slim fins + lean torso + broken plates; 2014 = short blunt fins + heaviest bulk. The broken/chipped plates are gvk-exclusive.
vs gxk pink — DISAMBIGUATE by color + glow: gvk is charcoal+blue with no body rim; gxk is magenta/pink with a full-silhouette pink self-illum rim. If the body glows pink it's gxk.
vs burning — gvk has NO lava cracks and NO body glow; burning has both.
hardAt40px: The 'razor maple-leaf' fin profile vs 2014's 'blunt slate' is a subtle shape delta — exaggerate it: noticeably narrower fin bases + taller tips so the sharpening reads at iso.
Battle-scar broken plates are a cheap 2-extra-vertex change (chipped flat top + notch) — keep 2 specific indices broken so the asymmetry is deterministic and visible.

The 6–8% torso narrowing is small — pair it with the taller/sharper ridge so the combined read is unmistakably 'leaner warrior' and not just 'same body, blue.' Resist adding a baked cyan rim — that would wrongly read as self-lit and blur gvk toward the gxk/supernova self-lit tiers.

Diamond-scale texture and elbow spikes are sub-pixel — drop them; the magenta colorway + glow + leaner build carry the ID.
Keep it clearly distinct from supernova by NOT over-bulking it and NOT adding fissures — gxk's identity is lean + pink, supernova's is huge + violet-cracked.

The body itself is dark but every seam, plate and the silhouette rim glow violet-white, like a creature at critical mass about to detonate.
mustHaveForBlindID: WHITE-VIOLET hue (NOT pink, NOT orange) — the locked endpoint color
Overgrown crystalline plates — visibly the tallest + most numerous ridge on the ladder
White-violet skin fissures (energy splitting the body, denser than burning's)
Biggest/bulkiest body + violet self-glow that lifts it off the night sky
LABEL as speculative — there is no released film design; it's the lineage-implied peak
commonMisreads: vs gxk pink — closest sibling. DISAMBIGUATE by HUE + bulk + cracks: gxk is hot PINK, leaner, no fissures; supernova is WHITE-VIOLET, biggest/bulkiest, WITH energy fissures + overgrown crystal plates. Pink+lean = gxk, violet+huge+cracked = supernova.
vs burning — both have fissures + self-glow. DISAMBIGUATE by hue: burning ORANGE, supernova WHITE-VIOLET; supernova's plates are far taller/more crystalline and its bulk is larger.

vs void_ghidorah (the roster's other near-black self-lit form) — supernova rim is VIOLET, void rim is CYAN, and the archetype silhouette is a single hunched plated wyrm vs a three-neck fan. Do NOT harmonize the two rim hues — the violet/cyan difference is load-bearing.
hardAt40px: Heaviest sprite in the roster — the per-plate glow halos can't all be drawn; imply the glowing crystal spine with ONE wide violet radial wash behind the ridge + the self-illum rim (not 16 individual halos), and cap the 3-stop crystal gradient to front-facing plates only.

Near-black body vs night sky (#05070f) is the critical failure mode — the violet self-illum rim around the torso path + raising the AO dark stop to ~#2a1448 is MANDATORY so it doesn't sink into the sky.
The ×1.4-height ×16 plates on a bulk-1.15 body risk clipping the 150×168 canvas top — verify bounds; the overgrown ridge is the identity, so cap height to fit rather than reducing count.

As a speculative form, prioritize the lineage-legible cues (overgrown crystal + violet energy cracks + huge bulk + self-glow) over any invented specifics — keep it readable as 'gxk pushed to nova,' not a new creature.

families.family: Mothra (flyer family) — divine four-winged moth goddess; identity carried 100% by the four-wing bilateral airborne silhouette + per-forewing-tip eyespot (ocellus), with a tiny furred thorax centered between the wings. Within-game escalation: t1 cool white+blue (2019) → t2 warm orange-bronze + blue joint bioluminescence (2024) → t3 speculative golden god-ray apotheosis. Reconciled against GKotM (2019) and GxK (2024) film/CG-data references; the redesign plan §3 is accurate and these specs confirm + sharpen it.

forms.character: Mothra (imago / adult form), Godzilla: King of the Monsters (2019)

forms.oneLineIdentity: A divine white-furred moth goddess with four orange-patterned wings, blue eyes, and a glowing-blue under-skin, descending with wings spread.

The combined four-wing span is the dominant mass — far wider than tall. Must read as a hovering/descending moth, NEVER a hunched lizard or biped.

ONE round EYESPOT (ocellus) per forewing tip — concentric black ring / blue iris / pale center — the non-negotiable brand mark
WHITE/cream furred thorax with a small brown-orange forehead tuft (body is fur, NOT a glowing cyan surface)
Two thick swept-back WHITE feathery antennae
Orange/amber/yellow wing pattern field with dark (near-black) wingtip borders — stained-glass translucent membranes
BLUE accent only: large oval blue eyes + blue under-skin bioluminescent glow (the glow is an ACCENT over white fur, not the body color)

mustHaveForBlindID: Four wings in a bilateral moth spread (2 large forewings + 2 smaller hindwings)
A round eyespot at EACH forewing tip (black ring → blue iris → pale center)
White/cream FURRED thorax body (not a cyan-glowing body) with white swept-back antennae
Orange-amber wing pattern with dark wingtip borders + a BLUE glow accent (eyes/under-skin), not a blue body
commonMisreads: Cyan-glowing biped/lizard — the original game bug; fix by making the BODY white fur and moving blue to glow accent only, and by using the airborne four-wing pose not a grounded walk
Rodan (warm airborne flyer) — disambiguate by ROUND eyespots + rounded 4-lobe wing shape (Rodan has angular scalloped single-spar triangles and no eyespots)
A single translucent blob when near/far wings smear together — disambiguate by raising far-wing alpha (~0.82) and offsetting the far forewing tip outward so all four wings read distinct
mothra_gxk (its own t2) — disambiguate by COOL white+blue body here vs warm orange-bronze body + blue joint dots there
hardAt40px: Concentric eyespot rings collapse — imply with just 2 nested ellipses (black ring + blue dot center), iris kept ≥ BH*0.09 even on the FAR wing
Thin antennae clip/vanish — thicken to ~3px white strokes, top at ~-BH*0.98 (pulled in from the canvas edge so they don't clip)
Fine wing banding is invisible — reduce to flat banded LAYERS (border / amber field / yellow root), no fine veins
Fur texture is lost — imply with one fuzzy stroked outline on the thorax oval rather than per-hair detail
Blue 'glow' read as a glowing body — keep blue as small bright accents (eyes, eyespot iris, faint under-sheen) so the body still reads as white fur

Many individual god-ray gradient objects are invisible at iso AND a bake-cost item — bake as a few flat low-alpha spokes + ONE soft radial gradient behind the thorax, not 10 gradient objects
Golden eyespot vs gold field low-contrast — keep the dark-gold ring + white-hot center so the eyespot still reads as a distinct eye against the gold wing

forms.character: King Ghidorah (MonsterVerse / Titanus Ghidorah / Monster Zero), Godzilla: King of the Monsters 2019
forms.era: MonsterVerse 2019 (Legendary)
forms.oneLineIdentity: A muscular three-headed golden space-dragon: a fan of three long ridged necks (center neck thrust FORWARD of the outer two), each head crowned with a back-swept Western horn-cluster, twin scalloped golden bat-wings behind, two forked-sickle tails, NO arms.
forms.silhouette: An upright wide three-prong neck-FAN dwarfing a small body, with twin bat-wings spread behind and two tails below. The defining read: the CENTER neck/head sits forward and higher than the two outer necks (asymmetric trident, not a symmetric three-prong). No arms — the wings are the only upper limbs. At 40px it must read as 'three snake necks + two wings,' never as a single-headed lizard.
signatureCues: Three serpentine necks splaying into a fan, center neck pushed FORWARD and ~1.1x larger / higher than the outer two (MV Ichi-dominant layout)
Golden coloration — warm metallic gold body, the brand color of the whole family
Back-swept HORN CLUSTER on each head (multiple thin curved prongs raked rearward, MV-style emotive crown), NOT a single pair
Twin golden bat-wings with a SCALLOPED trailing edge spread behind the necks (finger-spar membrane, distinct from Rodan's single-point wing)
Two tails each ending in a spiky SICKLE barb
Zero arms — wings are the forelimbs; never the wyrm arm-nubs
forms.materialFinish: Warm pebbled golden reptile scale with a soft metallic sheen — organic, not chromed. Necks ridged/skin-textured; wing membrane smooth gold leather. Lit by the one neutral warm-white key (RIM), house rim only — NOT self-lit.
mustHaveForBlindID: Three distinct serpentine necks in a fan (the single non-negotiable family read)
Center neck/head forward and dominant over the two outer ones (this is what marks it MonsterVerse specifically vs the symmetric Toho fan)
Gold body + GOLDEN (not purple) eye/beam/glow — the long-standing purple beam is a bug; brand is golden gravity lightning
Back-swept multi-prong horn crown on the heads
Twin bat-wings + two tails, no arms
commonMisreads: Heisei king_ghidorah (T2): same gold three-head fan — disambiguate by SCALE and HORN STYLE. MV is muscular with a soft emotive curved crown and forward center neck; Heisei is leaner/sharper with rigid straight devil-horns and prominent wing-tip hooks. Keep MV's center-forward asymmetry and softer crown to separate them.
Rodan (gold-adjacent airborne): disambiguate by HEAD COUNT (3 vs 1) and the neck-fan vs single horizontal wing-glider silhouette.
A generic two-winged dragon: the THREE necks are the only guarantee — if a viewer can't count three neck-prongs it fails.
hardAt40px: Per-head horn-cluster detail blurs — imply with a back-swept dark-core + RIM-lit triangular prong fan (drawRidgeElement) reading as a spiky silhouette notch, not individual horns.

Center-neck-forward depth cue is subtle at iso — sell it by drawing the center head HIGHER and slightly LARGER (1.1–1.12x) and overlapping it in FRONT of the outer two, plus one chipped horn on a side head for free asymmetry.
Wing scallops vanish as strokes — cut them as hard concave notches in the membrane fill so 'bat-wing' survives.
Sickle tail-barbs are sub-pixel — render as a small filled barb triangle at each tail tip rather than a thin hook.

forms.character: King Ghidorah (Heisei), Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah 1991
forms.era: Heisei 1991 (Toho)
forms.oneLineIdentity: The fully-organic apex Ghidorah: a brighter, more METALLIC gold three-head dragon with RIGID STRAIGHT devil-horns bristling down each head, a wider sharper-scaled neck fan, and pronounced HOOKED wing-tips — a Western-dragon redesign, leaner and meaner than MV.
forms.silhouette: Taller, wider three-neck fan than MV on a still-small upright body, twin large fin-like bat-wings with hooked tips, two tails. Necks read more muscular and serpentine; the crown is a rigid spiky devil-horn rack rather than a soft curved crown. Same family skeleton, visibly LEVELED-UP: taller fan, denser/longer horns, brighter gold.
signatureCues: Brighter, more METALLIC gold than MV — a clear value step up (lighter, cooler-specular gold)
RIGID STRAIGHT devil-horns running down the SIDES of each head (multiple straight prongs, Western-dragon style — not curved/emotive)
Wider + TALLER three-neck fan (bigger fan footprint than T1)
Pronounced HOOKED wing-tip on each fin-like bat-wing (the Heisei wing signature)
Sharper, more angular neck scale detail / defined neck musculature
No mane of hair (Heisei dropped the Showa neck manes); red reptilian eyes in film, gold in-game per family gold token
forms.materialFinish: Polished metallic golden scale — noticeably brighter and more reflective than MV's matte warm gold, with a thin near-white specular crest highlight (RIM) selling the 'more metallic' read. Sharper angular scale ticks along the neck crest. House rim only (not self-lit).
mustHaveForBlindID: Three-head gold fan that is VISIBLY brighter/taller/wider than the MV tier (the value+size gap is the whole differentiator)
STRAIGHT rigid horn rack (vs MV's curved crown) — the Heisei silhouette signature
Hooked wing-tips on fin-like bat-wings
Gold body, golden eye/beam (family gold token — NOT purple)
commonMisreads: MV ghidorah (T1): the dangerous twin. Disambiguate ENTIRELY by (a) brighter metallic gold value, (b) straight vs curved horns, (c) taller/wider fan, (d) symmetric fan (no center-forward dominance). If T1 and T2 share gold value they collapse — push T2's #f2c200 clearly lighter than T1's #d4a000.

grand_king (T4): also organic gold with antler horns — disambiguate by horn TYPE (Heisei = straight devil-horns on ALL heads; Grand King = FORKED center + straight sides) and bulk (Grand King is beefier/shorter-necked).
A generic gold dragon: again the three necks carry it.
hardAt40px: The brighter-vs-MV value gap is the primary cue and can wash out — bake a real luminance step (#f2c200 vs #d4a000) and a brighter specular crest so it survives.

Straight-vs-curved horn distinction is fine detail — sell straightness with a denser, longer, more vertical/rigid prong fan (4-per-side, +30% length, one hooked tall crown tip) so the rack reads 'spiky-rigid' at iso.
Wing-tip hooks are sub-pixel as strokes — cut the hook as a notch in the wing outline.
Neck scale-ticks won't read at iso — they are portrait-only; do not rely on them as the differentiator.

forms.character: Mecha-King Ghidorah, Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah 1991

The asymmetry between a blocky metal center and two organic gold sides is the silhouette hook.
signatureCues: Two OUTER necks/heads remain ORGANIC GOLD (gold horn-crowns, gold scale) — center is MACHINE
CENTER head is a boxy angular SILVER skull with a glowing CYAN eye/visor slit (not an organic eye) + segmented neck braces/cables on the cyber neck
SILVER-GREY armored plating on wings, chest, torso (hard-edged panels, full opacity — not a grey wash over a gold dragon)
Cyan machine glow accent (eye, beam, edge-stroke) against gold organics — the cold-metal vs warm-gold color contrast
Mechanical details: machine hand / electrical capture cables hint, metal wing panels with seams, mechanical tail tips
Triple-beam gravity laser charge from the center cyber head

palette.part: cyan eye / visor / beam / edge glow

forms.materialFinish: Split material: cold hard-edged brushed SILVER-GREY metal plating (machine center head, wings, chest, torso) with crisp panel seams and specular edges, set against warm organic GOLD scale on the two outer necks/heads. Cyan electronic glow on the machine parts. The two finishes must not blend — the contrast IS the character.
mustHaveForBlindID: The CENTER head is mechanical/silver while the TWO OUTER heads are organic gold — if all three heads match (all gold OR all grey) it fails and regresses to 'grey-painted dragon' or 'plain Ghidorah'
Cyan glow (eye/beam) on the machine center vs gold organic sides
Hard silver plating on wings/chest/torso at full opacity, with seams — not a translucent wash
Still unmistakably a three-neck Ghidorah fan (so it's not confused with the blocky single-head Mechagodzilla bipeds)
commonMisreads: Mechagodzilla / mecha bipeds: shares the silver+cyan machine look — disambiguate by the THREE-NECK HYDRA FAN silhouette (Mechagodzilla is a single-head blocky biped). The hydra outline is the separator.
void_ghidorah (T5, also cyan): both use cyan accents — disambiguate by material (Mecha = bright silver plating + gold organics; Void = dark indigo + thorns + wormhole, no plating).
Plain king_ghidorah greyed-out: the failure mode if the whole body greys uniformly. Must keep the two outer necks visibly GOLD.
hardAt40px: Per-head material split is the load-bearing cue and the hardest to convey small — exaggerate it: make the center head a distinctly BLOCKY/angular silhouette (vs the two smooth rounded gold heads) so the fan reads 'rounded-square-rounded' even before color resolves.
Cyan visor slit is tiny — render it as a bright horizontal cyan bar that pops against the silver skull.
Panel seams/rivets are sub-pixel — keep big plate FACETS (large flat silver panels with a value break) rather than fine seams; seams are portrait-only.
Neck-brace cable detail blurs — imply with 3–4 chunky horizontal dark bands across the center neck.

forms.character: Grand King Ghidorah (Super-Dragon), Rebirth of Mothra III 1998
forms.era: Heisei/Millennium-adjacent 1998 (Toho, Rebirth of Mothra trilogy)
forms.oneLineIdentity: The beefiest organic Ghidorah: a more MUSCULAR three-head gold dragon with shorter/thicker necks and a unique HORN ASYMMETRY — the CENTER head has FORKED, branching antler horns while the two SIDE heads have STRAIGHT antlers — radiant rich gold.
forms.silhouette: A heavier, thicker-built three-neck fan — necks slightly SHORTER and stockier than the other gold tiers, body bulkier, wings more intricate. The instantly-distinguishing silhouette is the CENTER head's branching/forked antler crown reading as a Y/antler mass, flanked by two straight-horned heads.
signatureCues: FORKED / branching antler horns on the CENTER head (each prong splits near the tip — the #1 Grand King identifier) vs STRAIGHT antlers on the two SIDE heads
More MUSCULAR, beefier body than other organic Ghidorahs
Shorter, THICKER necks (stocky, not the long thin fan)
Radiant rich/pale gold — the brightest, warmest gold of the organic tiers
More intricate wings (extra finger-spar, deeper trailing scallops)
Two tails, no arms — same family skeleton, scaled heavier
forms.materialFinish: Rich, bright, almost luminous pale-gold scale — the most saturated/radiant gold of the family with a warm gold aura. Thick muscular hide reading. House/gold-aura lit. The forked center crown is built as filled antler mass, not thin strokes.
mustHaveForBlindID: FORKED center-head horns + STRAIGHT side-head horns (the canonical asymmetry — without it this is just 'another gold Ghidorah')
Visibly BEEFIER/bulkier body + shorter, thicker necks than the other gold tiers
Brightest, richest pale gold + gold aura
Three-head fan, two tails, no arms
commonMisreads: king_ghidorah / ghidorah (other gold tiers): all organic gold three-heads — disambiguate by (a) the forked-center vs straight-all horns, (b) bulkier body + shorter thicker necks, (c) brightest pale-gold value. The forked center crown is the load-bearing separator.
A symmetric three-head dragon: the whole point is the horn ASYMMETRY between center and sides — keep them clearly different shapes.
Mothra/gold flyers: head count (3 vs 1) and the upright neck-fan separate it.
hardAt40px: Branching antler detail collapses — build the forked center crown as a Y-shaped FILLED triangular mass (two sub-prongs sharing a base) reading as antler bulk, so the fork survives as silhouette where straight side-horns read as single prongs.
Shorter-thicker-neck cue is subtle — exaggerate neck base width (~BH*0.135) and shorten length (neckLenMul ~0.92) so the fan reads stocky vs the lean tiers.
Bulk delta is small at iso — push bodyBulk ~1.18 and let the heavier outline carry it.
Brightest-gold value can wash against other gold tiers at night — pair the pale body with deeper-gold (#d4a000) shadow contrast so it doesn't flatten.

forms.character: Void Ghidorah / God of the Void / King of the Void, Godzilla: The Planet Eater 2018 (anime trilogy)
forms.era: AniGoji 2018 (Polygon/Toho anime)
forms.oneLineIdentity: An extra-dimensional ENERGY being with NO solid body: three impossibly long, thin, WRITHING golden necks bristling with rose-like THORNS, descending from a glowing WORMHOLE/singularity overhead — cosmic horror, the only Ghidorah that breaks the dragon mold.
forms.silhouette: Three extremely long, thin, sinuous S-curving necks emerging from a glowing portal disc, studded with outward thorns, ending in bristly spike-crowned heads. NO body, NO wings, NO legs, NO tails in the normal sense — just necks + portal. The writhing-rose-stem read is the entire silhouette; it must look alien, not like a standard winged dragon.
signatureCues: THREE extremely long, thin, WRITHING necks (longest/thinnest of all tiers) emerging from a glowing wormhole — no normal body
Rose-THORN studding: numerous outward-pointing spikes/thorns along the necks and bristly spike-crowns on the heads (patterned after thorned roses)
Glowing WORMHOLE / singularity DISC at the neck-root origin (cyan core radial gradient) the necks descend from
Dark indigo body LIFTED by a luminous CYAN crest rim (+ thin gold center vein) so it reads as a golden void-entity edge-lit against the night, never sinking into the sky
Cyan void-flame eyes/beam (not gold, not purple)
Fixed sinuous S-curve baked into each neck (deterministic writhe present in every frame)
forms.materialFinish: Not solid scale — a dark cosmic energy-being: near-black indigo necks that would vanish into the night sky except for a self-illuminating CYAN rim along every crest (thorn tips catch the cyan), with a thin gold center vein. Granted the full self-illumination rim (§1.2/§1.5). The wormhole disc is a cyan-core radial-gradient glow.
mustHaveForBlindID: Three impossibly long, thin, writhing thorny necks coming out of a glowing PORTAL — no body, no wings (the form that breaks the dragon mold)
Rose-THORN spikes all along the necks and heads (the canonical design DNA)
Cyan self-illumination rim that keeps the dark body visible against night sky (mandatory — it vanishes without it)
Cyan void-flame (not the gold of organic tiers)
commonMisreads: Other Ghidorah tiers (winged gold dragons): Void has NO wings, NO solid body, NO tails — just thorny necks + portal. If it grows wings or a normal torso it reads as 'dark Ghidorah' and fails.
mecha_ghidorah (also cyan): Mecha is bright silver plating + gold organics + wings; Void is dark indigo, thorny, no plating, wormhole origin. Material and the portal separate them.

supernova (Godzilla, dark body + self-lit rim twin): safely separated by silhouette (single hunched plated wyrm vs three writhing necks) AND rim hue (violet vs cyan) — do NOT harmonize the two rim colors.
Sinking into the #05070f night sky: the failure mode if the cyan rim is dropped — the dark indigo body is near-sky luminance.
hardAt40px: Thin writhing necks risk reading as noise — keep them as a clear deterministic S-curve and ensure the cyan rim outlines them so the writhe is legible.
Many small thorns blur — render 5–7 per neck as small FILLED triangles (length ~BH*0.03) alternating sides; ensure at least the larger ones survive as silhouette bumps; thorn tips catch the cyan rim.
The wormhole disc can clip the canvas bottom (sits near anchor Y) — nudge it up so the ~BW*0.9 radial doesn't get cut.
Dark body invisibility is the chronic risk — the cyan rim is mandatory and the AO dark-stop must stay above pure black; verify the silhouette lifts off the sky in a night-render test.

families.family: Rodan (flyer / pteranodon family) — 3 canonical forms (rodan = Showa 1956/64, rodan_mv = MonsterVerse Titanus Rodan 2019, rodan_fire = Heisei Fire Rodan 1993). Shared family silhouette (plan §5.1, §7): a 3/4-front airborne PTERANODON — ONE dominant horizontal WING SPAN as the dominant mass, a NARROW horizontal body slung between the wings (never the hunched upright wyrm torso), a backswept pointed HEAD-CREST, a long DOWN-ANGLED BEAK leading the body, two small TUCKED talons under the chest, near-absent tail. The non-negotiable silhouette triangle is WING + CREST + BEAK, angular/raptor — it must NEVER smear into Mothra's rounded two-lobe blob, which is enforced by a SCALLOPED (finger-notch) trailing edge cut as a hard shape on every wing. Across the 3-tier arc the constant is that triangle; what escalates is HEAT: cold brown rock-pteranodon (no glow) -> dark volcanic-rock fire-demon with magma-crack seams + glowing/dripping wing underside -> incandescent vermilion magma-comet with gold crest/spikes + black beak + white-hot cracks. Both rodan & mothra are AIRBORNE: same drawAltitudeShadow recipe, same idle-flap cadence (plan §1.3, §7). Rendered procedural Canvas2D at ~40px iso, baked to a 150x168 sprite, anchor (75,144.5). Shared helpers: drawPteranoBody, drawCrestHorns, drawChestSpikes, drawTuckedTalons, reworked drawPteranoWing, drawMagmaCracks (= shared drawFissures). NOTE: this family has NO speculative member of its own — there is no rodan_supernova. The two speculative forms named in the brief (supernova, mothra_supernova) belong to the WYRM and MOTHRA families respectively; they are included below, clearly labeled, for cross-family disambiguation reference since both are airborne/radiant and could be confused at the palette level.

Enormous wings disproportionately larger than the slim body — the body looks small/under-slung between them
Long pointed DOWN-CURVED beak leading the body (jagged raptor head)
A short row of SHARP bone chest/sternum spikes (the canonical 'spiky chest')
Scalloped (finger-notch) wing trailing edge cut as a hard shape — instantly not-Mothra

Burgundy/charcoal volcanic body, not a flat brown
Massive serrated beak
